messages:
Marta L: Heads-up: final SEO runway for Plume Orbit launch this week. Need: consolidated kw map, schema snippets for landing + 2 posts, internal anchor plan, and redirects sheet. Can we lock by EOD Tue?

Diego V: I'll own internal linking + anchor suggestions. Focusing on CTAs: 'inference latency', 'real-time LLM', 'cost per token'. Will flag any thin pages.

Leah P: I'll do schema + FAQ and surface-level meta/title checks. Propose Article schema on posts, Event + Webinar schema on landing, and FAQPage on the main post only.

Carmen (publishing-bot): Reminder: redirect CSV must be UTF-8, header: source,target,type. Use 301 for permanent consolidation.

Diego V: sample redirect rows I'm planning:```source,target,type
/old-plume-guide,/plume-orbit,301
/plume-livestream-2026,/plume-orbit,301
```

Leah P: JSON-LD for webinar landing draft: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Plume Orbit: Real-time Inference","startDate":"2026-05-05T18:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.ai/plume-orbit"}``` Will expand with speaker Person objects once confirmed.

Marta L: Keyword mapping: please map top 6 kws to primary post, secondary KW to benchmarks post, and long-tails to evergreen guide. Diego, add anchor targets in the doc: https://drive.google.com/PLUME-ORBIT-ANCHORS

SEO-Agent (olivia): Quick alert: meta-description length OK, but duplicate H1 detected between /plume-orbit and /plume-orbit-benchmarks. Recommend subtle H1 tweak on benchmarks: add year or 'results'.

Diego V: noted. I'll change anchor text on internal links to avoid exact-match over-optimization. Also propose a 2-week canonicalization hold before sweeping redirects to monitor traffic.

Marta L: Acceptance checklist: 1) redirects CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-orbit.csv and deployed with `/deploy redirects plume-orbit`; 2) schema present on landing + primary post + evergreen guide; 3) internal anchors live in copy; 4) sitemap updated and submitted; 5) GTM params for webinar links set.

Leah P: GTM params suggested: `?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=plume_orbit_may` - we'll append `&variant=A` for the FAQ A/B test.

Carmen (publishing-bot): After upload, run `publishing-bot check-schema https://www.redwood.ai/plume-orbit` and post results.

Marta L: Everyone drop a 1-line status in the planning sheet by 6pm. If anything blocks deploy, ping eng-infra and tag @deploy-oncall. Thanks! :rocket:
